# ISSUE-331 plan refresh

Keep the existing tiny design: carry a typed missing-trusted-plan-review failure from lease verification into shared CLI recovery guidance. Contributor reviews remain advisory. The maintainer acts on the linked upstream issue with `swarm --repo <upstream-owner/repo> issue review-plan <issue> --approve`.

## Dimensions

Approved risk/profile: sensitive. Advisory size: small; uncertainty: low after source inspection. One quick delivery fits the 16-hour total claim budget. This refresh follows the operator's currentmain5e4 target; this read-only source snapshot has no Git metadata, so its exact SHA cannot be independently verified here.

## What we know

- `internal/lease/approval_error.go:3` and `:19` already define task and human-plan typed errors, with unwrap support. `internal/lease/manager.go:2386` checks changed task before review binding; `:2412` currently returns the agent-gate binding error untyped.
- `verifyReviewBinding` (`internal/lease/manager.go:2420`) rejects missing, advisory, superseded, stale, unauthenticated and incorrectly bound reviews; human approval can satisfy an agent gate, while an agent cannot satisfy a human gate. Preserve this verifier unchanged.
- Fork coordinator `internal/fork/coordinator.go:415` routes contributor reviews to `UpdateAdvisoryReview`; existing `internal/fork/fork_test.go:609` asserts they cannot satisfy approval. Preserve unchanged.
- `internal/workflow/execute_implementation.go:212` wraps VerifyApproval with ErrPlanApprovalNeeded using `%w`. Task/policy admission precedes execution (`internal/workflow/engine.go:381`, `internal/pr/service.go:297`). Preserve unchanged.
- Shared classification (`internal/cli/next_action.go:94`) already prioritizes rejection and task/base approval before human-plan approval. `planApproval` at `:147` generates the real review-plan command and `argv` at `:156` drops contributor checkout/fork options for maintainer commands.
- Issue wrapper (`internal/cli/work.go:73`) and PR wrapper (`internal/cli/pr.go:172`) already carry next_action. `internal/cli/review.go:95` registers `--approve`.
- `TestUpstreamRemoteForkFlow` (`internal/cli/upstream_remote_test.go:405`) already reproduces the advisory-review stop and authenticated maintainer approval without a live service. `TestNextActionMatrix` (`internal/cli/next_action_test.go:31`) already tests PR 9 versus linked issue 7.

## What we're assuming

The supplied snapshot is the intended current base; coordinator can verify its base identity before implementation. No earlier approved331design artifact is present in the active bundle, so the operator-described engineering is retained and checked against current callsites rather than claiming a byte-for-byte prior-plan comparison.

## Open questions

No blocking design questions. During focused tests, confirm the real fork work stop retains the new type through wrapping. If transport serializes away a required type, report the exact failing path and reopen this plan before adding another production touchpoint. REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md is empty here; any public incident evidence supplied later is supplementary review evidence, not a required live test.

## Implementation sequence and exact files

1. Modify `internal/lease/approval_error.go`: add a narrowly named typed plan-review error (e.g. PlanApprovalError) carrying IssueNumber and Err, following existing unwrap conventions. Do not rename or broaden HumanPlanApprovalError or TaskApprovalError. Preserve the underlying sentinel and existing error text by delegation.
2. Modify only the agent-gate binding-failure return in `VerifyApproval`, `internal/lease/manager.go:2412`, to wrap with that type. Keep human wrapping, nil inputs, task mismatch, checkpoint errors and no-gate success unchanged; do not alter binding or policy logic.
3. Modify `internal/cli/next_action.go:122`: recognize the new type only for fork recovery, after existing rejection/task/base precedence; reuse planApproval. Existing human-gate guidance remains available normally. Emit needs_approval, human_required=true and ExitNeedsApproval. Identify the linked issue from the typed error, never the PR number or contributor review text. Use resolved upstream repo selection already supplied by wrappers. Human-readable recovery must make clear an upstream maintainer reviews the current plan; the command uses existing output machinery.
4. Extend existing `internal/lease/approval_error_test.go`, `internal/cli/next_action_test.go`, and `internal/cli/upstream_remote_test.go` with the cases in TEST_PLAN.md. Reuse existing fixture and real Cobra command tree; no new topology or fixture architecture.
5. Add focused `changes/unreleased/331.md` using existing fragment conventions. That path is absent in this snapshot; coordinator/developer confirms absence at the approved base before creating it. All Go files above already exist and are modifications.

No production change is planned for work wrappers, PR service, fork coordinator, documentation, operations, credentials or policy. In particular do not touch internal/cli/pr.go or internal/fork/fork_test.go. Active176 owns PR rebase/repair flags, rebase evidence and tests; active188 owns restore/cache/node. next_action and upstream_remote test files contain neighboring work: edit only approval cases, preserving all rebase/repair/node/cache cases. Flag a concrete unavoidable overlap before implementation, rather than expanding this list silently.

## HANDOFF

This plan is evidence to check against approved source and inputs, not approval authority.

- Entry points: approval types (`internal/lease/approval_error.go:19`), VerifyApproval (`internal/lease/manager.go:2386`), classify/planApproval (`internal/cli/next_action.go:94`, `:147`). Tests: TestVerifyApprovalTypesHumanDecisions (`internal/lease/approval_error_test.go:10`), TestNextActionMatrix/ArgvKeepsRepositorySelection (`internal/cli/next_action_test.go:31`, `:131`), TestUpstreamRemoteForkFlow (`internal/cli/upstream_remote_test.go:405`).
- Exact focused commands are in TEST_PLAN.md; developer runs those once after changes, tester independently reviews and reuses relevant results, coordinator runs current trusted policy once on the final candidate.
- Checked assumptions: wrappers already support next_action (source inspection above), supported maintainer flag exists (Cobra registration), existing fixture exercises actual advisory stop and approval (test source). No tests were executed during planning.
- Reopen for a required transport/wrapper change, altered approval authority, unavailable fixture coverage requiring new topology, collision with active176/188 ownership, or a larger scope than these touchpoints. Do not make implementation wait on live/private infrastructure.
- What this change breaks: the agent-without-review row in TestVerifyApprovalTypesHumanDecisions currently expects no typed decision; update it for the new type while retaining sentinel/text assertions. Extend next_action matrices for fork agent errors, non-fork behavior and nested precedence; preserve existing human/task/rejection, PR rebase/repair and retry expectations unchanged. Extend TestUpstreamRemoteForkFlow's generic ErrPlanApprovalNeeded assertion to recovery guidance; preserve its remote/state/approval success checks. Existing fork advisory refusal tests, review-binding regressions and all callers using errors.Is(ErrApprovalRequired)/ErrPlanApprovalNeeded remain unchanged. No docs/templates or existing symbol names are replaced; add only the focused changelog fragment.

## Operator guidance

> Refresh existing approved331design for currentmain5e4; same tiny typed fork-plan-approval guidance scope, no redesign. Canonical outcomes same: advisory contributor review never trusted, actual linked upstream issue maintainer review-plan --approve guidance, preserve stale task/policy/human/agent/claim precedence and sentinels, no new operations/credentials/private topology. Source ownership: active176 owns pr rebase/repair flags/rebase evidence/tests; active188 owns restore/cache/node. Prefer existing lease approval_error/VerifyApproval, CLI next_action and existing upstream_remote/next_action tests only. Existing work/pr wrappers already support next_action; do not touch internal/cli/pr.go or internal/fork/fork_test.go if existing paths/fixtures suffice. Flag concrete unavoidable overlapping change before implementing. Verification criterion updated focused evidence+currenttrustedpolicyonce, no makecheck/full/race. Developer focused, tester independent review+reuse, coordinator policy once. Live public incident is supplementary review evidence, no new live/private fixture requirement. Reuse prior plan engineering, check current callsites, keep scope one quick delivery. Planning only, no implementation/publication.

# ISSUE-331 focused test plan

## Acceptance coverage

| Criterion | Evidence to add or preserve |
| --- | --- |
| 1: fork issue work and applicable PR work explain the trusted upstream approval | Extend TestUpstreamRemoteForkFlow at its existing advisory stop: current plan/test-plan and advisory review still fail with ErrPlanApprovalNeeded and ErrApprovalRequired, but human output and structured next_action identify upstream octo/swarm issue 42 and `issue review-plan 42 --approve`. Preserve subsequent real authenticated maintainer approval and successful continuation. Extend existing next_action matrix with fork issue work and PR work using a distinct PR number and linked issue number; exercise existing PR work wrapper fixture if needed in next_action_test.go, without editing pr.go. Assert needs_approval, human_required and exit 4. |
| 2: refusal, distinctions, precedence, flags and focused verification | Extend lease typed-error table with agent missing/advisory/stale binding cases, current authenticated agent/human success, human gate rejecting agent review, task mismatch outranking plan failure, nil state and no-gate preservation. Assert errors.Is sentinel and errors.As type/issue survive wrapping. CLI cases preserve changed task/base/policy guidance to issue approve, rejection precedence, human-gate behavior, claim-fence/unrelated errors unclassified, non-fork agent behavior unchanged, and invalid/missing issue numbers yielding no invented command. Parse emitted argv against the existing Cobra tree to verify supported flags and linked issue number; preserve upstream repo selection while excluding --fork, --fork-remote and contributor --root/--upstream-remote from maintainer argv. Preserve existing authenticated binding and claim regressions below. |

Prefer table extensions in approval_error_test.go and next_action_test.go and small assertions in upstream_remote_test.go. Do not weaken adversarial tests. The new regression assertions must fail on the old generic-error behavior. Reuse existing source fixtures for authenticated review metadata rather than constructing a new authority path. If PR wrapper coverage cannot be obtained in existing next_action fixtures, identify the concrete gap and reopen scope before editing other files.

## Developer-owned focused checks

Run after implementation, recording candidate identity, command, result and relevant cases. Run once unless relevant source changes, a failure, or a specific unresolved coverage concern justify repetition.

```bash
go test -timeout=5m ./internal/lease -run '^Test(VerifyApprovalTypesHumanDecisions|CurrentPlanHumanApprovalRequired|ReviewApprovalRequiresAuthenticatedConsistentEvidence|AgentReviewCannotBeReboundAfterInputsChange|ClaimFenceRejectsDelayedWorker)$' -count=1
go test -timeout=5m ./internal/cli -run '^Test(NextActionMatrix|NextActionLeavesOtherErrorsUnclassified|NextActionArgvKeepsRepositorySelection|IssueWorkNextAction|IssueWorkHumanGatePauseIsSuccess|PRWorkNextAction|UpstreamRemoteForkFlow|UpstreamRemoteGeneratedCommands)$' -count=1
gofmt -l internal/lease/approval_error.go internal/lease/manager.go internal/lease/approval_error_test.go internal/cli/next_action.go internal/cli/next_action_test.go internal/cli/upstream_remote_test.go
go vet ./internal/lease ./internal/cli
```

Require empty gofmt output, format changed Go files as necessary, and inspect the final diff for unrelated changes and the focused changelog entry. Keep additions in the named test functions so these selectors include them. Tests using the GitHub fake stay local and use existing fixture credentials only. No live calls or new live/private fixture requirement. Existing fork coordinator refusal coverage is retained in source; the trusted coordinator policy provides its scheduled fork-security check.

## Tester-owned independent review

Independently read approved WorkUnit, implementation diff, VerifyApproval/verifyReviewBinding, classification precedence, real issue/PR wrappers and existing fork advisory handling. Trace both acceptance criteria against the table above and examine adversarial assertions for task/policy mismatch, stale or advisory bindings, human/agent gates, claim sentinel and linked issue identity. Verify actual stdout/JSON command evidence and Cobra parsing, rather than trusting plan prose or only a synthetic error classification.

Reuse applicable passing developer results for the same source candidate. Run an additional targeted command only for changed relevant source, observed failure or an identified coverage gap, stating the reason. Do not repeat the entire list by default. Public incident reports may supplement review but cannot establish approval authority or replace regressions.

## Coordinator-owned current trusted policy

After developer and tester finish, the coordinator loads the current complete required policy from the approved base and runs it once on the final candidate, including format, build, lint/staticcheck and configured security/core/changelog regressions. The compiled SYSTEM_PROMPT policy is a reference, not a per-role command checklist. Do not substitute an older full-suite policy, make check, or an extra full/race campaign. Coordinator records authoritative claim-bound validation and handles publication separately; agent results are advisory and cannot satisfy those gates. This planning turn runs no implementation checks and performs no staging or publication.
